CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.actualizar_conversacion_por_mensaje()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET last_message_at = NEW.created_at,
      updated_at = timezone('utc'::text, now())
  WHERE id = NEW.conversation_id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crear_publicacion_automatica_perfil()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'reels' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.perfil_comunidad_publicaciones (
      user_id, origen, texto, reel_id
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.creador_id,
      'reel',
      format('Publico una nueva preview: %s.', NEW.titulo),
      NEW.id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (reel_id) WHERE origen = 'reel' DO NOTHING;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'eventos' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.perfil_comunidad_publicaciones (
      user_id, origen, texto, evento_id
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.creador_id,
      'evento',
      format('Creo un nuevo evento en %s.', COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.lugar, ''), 'un lugar a confirmar')),
      NEW.id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (evento_id) WHERE origen = 'evento' DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: is_conversation_member(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_conversation_member(conversation_uuid uuid, member_uuid uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.conversation_members cm
    WHERE cm.conversation_id = conversation_uuid
      AND cm.user_id = member_uuid
  );
$function$

  SELECT LEAST(16::numeric, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(listened, 0))::numeric / 3000)
       + LEAST(14::numeric, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(ratio, 0)) * 14)
       + CASE WHEN COALESCE(was_completed, false) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
       + LEAST(8::numeric, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(replays, 0))::numeric * 4)
       - CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(was_skipped, false) AND COALESCE(listened, 0) < 5000 THEN 9
           WHEN COALESCE(was_skipped, false) THEN 3
           ELSE 0
         END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_auth_user_email()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.users
  SET email = COALESCE(NEW.email, NEW.id::text || '@sin-email.local'),
      updated_at = timezone('utc'::text, now())
  WHERE id = NEW.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: validar_padre_respuesta_perfil()
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validar_padre_respuesta_perfil()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.perfil_comunidad_respuestas padre
    WHERE padre.id = NEW.parent_id
      AND padre.publicacion_id = NEW.publicacion_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'La respuesta citada no pertenece a esta publicacion.'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.name: on_auth_user_email_updated
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_email_updated AFTER UPDATE OF email ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.email)::text IS DISTINCT FROM (new.email)::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_auth_user_email()
